title: JUMP production paper: jump_rr-compatible compound tables
description:
Frozen, paper-consistent jump_rr tables generated from the JUMP production paper's compound-only compound_no_source7 CellProfiler/Harmony profile. This independent historical archive contains compound similarity matches, CellProfiler feature rankings with restored feature names, Datasette metadata, checksums, and machine-readable provenance.

It does not replace the living JUMP Hub / jump_rr release. The generator is retained on the jump-rr-production-profiles branch. Interactive links are documented in the included README.

creators.name: Muñoz, Alán F.
creators.affiliation: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard

notes: The activity artifact covers 112,462 of 112,604 profile compounds; 142 compounds therefore have no activity value (141 after negative controls are excluded from feature ranking). Source 7 is intentionally excluded to match the paper.
